 Capricorn Shani Horoscope Today, 16 November 2026: Sun in Vishakha, and Shani Rewards a Calm Approach to Your Home

 Neeraj Dhankher / TOI Astrology / Nov 16, 2026, 05:45 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Steady hands make for a steady household for Capricorn this Monday. The Sun leaves Libra today and enters Scorpio, beginning the last part of its journey through Vishakha nakshatra. Scorpio is your eleventh house of gains, friends and support networks. Vishakha is a determined star that pushes for results. At the same time, Mars, lord of your fourth house of home, sits in Leo, your eighth house, beside Jupiter and Ketu. Shani, your ruling planet, is retrograde in Pisces in your third house and asks you to handle household matters without rushing or reacting. Ambition Meets Home Life 
 Vishakha’s energy is goal-focused, and the Sun’s arrival in your eleventh house can make you eager to improve everything at once. Perhaps you want a bigger home, quick repairs or a new rule for the family. The intention is good. But pushing too hard at home tends to create friction rather than progress. Pick one household matter to improve this week and leave the rest for later. Shani Values Calm Over Speed 
 Shani in your third house governs effort and communication. It rewards patience in how you speak to family members and how you plan changes. If a disagreement over money, chores or space arises, lower your voice and give others time to respond. A calm conversation today can settle what a heated one would only complicate. A Possible Surprise at Home 
 Mars, joining Jupiter in your eighth house, can bring sudden costs or news linked to the household, such as an unexpected repair, an in-law’s request or a paperwork issue. Jupiter’s presence helps you handle it sensibly. Ketu may make the matter seem confusing at first. Gather facts before deciding anything. Join conversation

 Friends and Your Own Mood Offer Support 
 With the Sun in your eleventh house, friends or an elder sibling may offer practical help or good advice about home matters. Accept it. The Moon also travels through your own sign in Shravana, making you more receptive to what others say. Venus, your yogakaraka, and Mercury are both moving direct, so planning household budgets and talks becomes easier this week. What to Do Today 
 Choose one household issue to focus on and leave others for later. Speak calmly during family discussions and give others time to share their views. If an unexpected home expense arises, gather full details before reacting. Accept advice or help from friends and siblings. Avoid making big changes to home routines in one go. Shani Remedy for Today 
 Light a ghee lamp in the north-east corner of your home each evening this week and pray for peace in the household. Donate a set of curtains or bedsheets to a shelter home.
